profile.headline: VP, Senior Software Engineer at Loopthy
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with 18+ years of experience building enterprise web, mobile, and integrated software solutions, including approximately 7 years of hands-on testing and test automation. Experience in architecture decisions, code reviews, mentoring, and delivery coordination, alongside API development, AWS, databases, and CI/CD. Delivered applications for reporting, IoT, banking, payments, airline maintenance, and hotel management.

positions.title: VP, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to architecture decisions, reviewed other developers' code, coordinated delivery, and worked directly with clients. Handled requirements, UI design, frontend and backend development, and deployment for RepGenX, MIGRO, and BioFacialID.
- Collaborated on the design and development of RepGenX using React and Node.js. Automated calculations, template population, and data consolidation to accelerate EPAct report generation and reduce human errors.
- Contributed to the design and development of MIGRO using React Native and Node.js, integrating IoT functionality so users could manage, monitor, and control their outdoor smart switches in one app.
- Contributed to the design and development of BioFacialID using React Native and Node.js, integrating an existing facial-recognition service into an online banking security module for authentication and transaction approval.
- Collaborated on the development of REST APIs, external service integrations, authentication and authorization workflows, and database-driven backend functionality. Used AWS EC2 for hosting, S3 for file storage, and CloudFront to deliver website content and files from S3.
- Wrote and maintained unit tests with Jest and Mocha, BDD scenarios with Cucumber, and REST API tests with Postman to validate application behavior and integrations.
- Executed automated tests in Bamboo CI/CD pipelines and troubleshot failures; investigated application issues across UI, API, backend, and database layers using SQL and data validation.

positions.title: Senior Enterprise Software Developer Lead
positions.description:
- Led enterprise payment software development, reviewed code, mentored developers, assigned work, and coordinated releases.
- Contributed to the architecture of the DirexX payment gateway and developed, tested, documented, and debugged earlier versions.
- Collaborate with the design and development of the PowaPOS T25 Demo App for Android and iOS and TransFirst Tablet Register, bringing payments, barcode scanning, receipt printing, and cash drawer control into a single checkout workflow; managed App Store and Google Play submissions.
- Developed applications using Java/J2EE, Spring, Hibernate, SmartGWT, MySQL, JavaScript, Sencha Touch, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Wrote JUnit unit tests and Selenium UI scripts to support repeatable regression testing and identify defects before release; helped define test cases and acceptance criteria.
- Tested REST and SOAP web services with SoapUI and conducted load and performance testing with JMeter.
- Resolved integration issues to improve reliability and used SQL and database validation to investigate defects across application, service, and database layers.

positions.title: Interface Programmer
positions.description:
- Collaborated on the development of Trax airline maintenance and engineering software and web services using Java, Hibernate, SmartGWT, and Oracle.
- Contributed on the implementation of TRAX Interface Web Console, a SmartGWT web application for testing TRAX web services.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the design and implementation of eHotel's Frontdesk, PrintDesigner, and Housekeeper modules using Delphi 6 and Oracle/PL/SQL.
- Synchronized room availability between the central reservations center and the hotel chain using Oracle Advanced Queuing (AQ); also worked with Oracle Streams Replication and VisualSourceSafe 2005.
